link: THAMBULO YA MUṰA WA MUKALAHA YO GUMA TSHIVHIDZONI TSHA MAUNGANI
text:
KHUNGEDZELO







Ho vha hu mupfhufhi u si mphire ngei Tshivhidzoni tsha Maungani kha wadi 18, musi Meyara wa Masipalawapo wa Thulamela, Vho Athongozwiḓivha Sarah Rambuḓa, vho ya nga tsha vhukoma u thetshelesa zwililo zwa vhadzulapo, nga Ḽavhuṱanu, 08 Ṱhafamuhwe 2024.                        



Sa nga nga nzulele, Cllr Rambuḓa vho thoma nga u gonya thavhani u luvha Khosi Vho Masiagwala NW he vha fhelekedzwa nga Tshipikara Vho Muṱheiwana FA khathihi na komiti khulwane ya ha masipala.  Nga murahu ha u ṱanganedzwa shangoni ḽa Maungani, ḽine ḽo vhandekana na ḓorobo ya Ṱhohoyanḓou, tsini na Yunivesithi ya Venḓa, murumba wo mbo ḓi ṱambela tshanḓa.                                                





U bva musanda, muduba wo mbo ḓi livha muṱani wa mukalaha Vho Musiwalwo Joseph Raḽigilinga vha Maungani, Thondoni, vhane ndi mushai ane a dzula nḓuni yo fhaṱwaho nga mavu ya fulelwa nga mahatsi. Vho Raḽigilinga vho tou topoliwa nga tshitshavha uri vho fanelwa nga u fhaṱelwa nnḓu nga muvhuso, uri vha kone khwinisa vhutshilo havho na ha muṱa wavho u katelaho mufumakadzi wavho na vhaḓuhulu.                            








Vha tshi posa maipfhi a ndivhuwo, Vho Raḽigilinga vho ri: “Masipala wo mpfhesesa, zwithu zwanga zwi tou ga zwi ḓo luga. Ndi livhuwa Vho Meyara, mukhantselarawapo na musanda vhaṋe vha mavu.”



Meyara Vho Rambuḓa vho fhulufhedzisa uri Vho Raḽigilinga nnḓu vha ḓo guma vho fhaṱelwa. “Ri fhano Maungani kha ḽa musanda Vho Masiagwala, ro ḓa sa masipala wa Thulamela, ri tshi khou ḓisa tshumelo.”                            



 Vho Rambuḓa vho ri: “Musi ri henefha ro ṱangana na muṱa wa Vho Raḽigilinga hune ro wana zwithu zwi songo tou dzulisea zwone hu si na vhudzulo, hune ndi mukalaha na mukegulu wavho na zwiḓuhulu zwavho. Ro wana uri zwo fanela uri ri sie ro vha sumbedzisa uri ri khou ya u vha ḓisela nnḓu, ine ya ḓo shandukisa vhutshilo havho ha vha na u vhonala uri hu na mbonelanṱha. Ro ḓa hafha ri masipala wa Thulamela hu na Vho Muṱheiwana FA vhane vha vha tshipikara, miraḓo ya komiti khulwane, makhantseḽara a dziwadi, Foramu ya Vhafunzi vha Thulamela khathihi na komiti ya African Union. Roṱhe ro takuwa na vhakoma vha fhano Maungani na vhomakhadzi. Ro ḓa u vha dziṱhanzi uri Vho Raḽigilinga  vha kone u wana vhudzulo ha khwine”.       





Musi Vhamusanda vha tshi zwa, Khosi Vho Masiagwala vho ri a vha na mafhungo manzhi, vha tou vha na dakalo ḽihulu.                            








“Zwiṱirakitsha zwoṱhe kha zwi pfhe zwo ṱanganedziwa. Zwine Thulamela vha khou ri itela zwone u bva mahoḽa, ndi zwihulwane ngamaanḓa, Vha khou kona u vhona uri zwisiwana ndi mini nahone vha ya zwi thusa. Ndo ima hafha ndi tshi ri ndo takalesa, a si havha fhedzi ṋanwaha vhane vha khou fhiwa nnḓu.



Ha vha ndi vha vhuraru, zwi tshi khou itiswa nga Vho Meyara na khabinethe yavho na mukhantseḽara wa wadi 18 yashu. Vho no vha hone makhantseḽara fhedzi a hu na o no itaho zwi no fhira zwo no khou itwa nga Cllr Ṋelushi TA”. Mbekanyamushumo yo khunyelela luvhanḓeni lwa Beuster he Vho Meyara, makhantseḽara na vhashumi vha Thulamela vha thetshelesa tshaidzo dza vhadzulapo dzi kwamaho nḓisedzo ya tshumelo ya muvhuso wapo.

link: THULAMELA VHO FHULUFHEDZISA U FHAṰELA MUHOLEFHALI NNḒU
text:
Nga PHUMUDZO MAKHARAMEDZHA



Ho vha hu si mupfufhi u si mphire ngei tshivhidzoni tsha Masipala wa Thulamela, kha Wadi 31, tsho farelwaho luvhanḓeni lwa muvhundu wa Vonḓo ḽa Thavha nga Ḽavhuṱanu, 27 Khubvumedzi 2024, he vhadzulapo vha ḓisa thaidzo dzavho dza nḓisedzo ya tshumelo.





Meyara Cllr Vho Athongozwiḓivha Sarah Rambuḓa, vho ri u swika luvhanḓeni vha ṱanganedzwa nga mitshino ya sialala i katelaho tshikona na tshigombela.








Vhadzulapo vho no paḓa sumbe vho no bva kha zwiimiswa zwo fhambanaho zwa tshitshavha zwi katelaho vhaaluwa, vhulimi, siviki, mutakalo na vhaswa vho takuwa vha amba nga ha thaidzo dzine vha khou ṱangana nadzo.



Musi vha sa athu swika tshivhidzoni, Vho Meyara vho ranga phanḓa vhurumelwa vhu katelaho makhantseḽara na vhashumi vha muvhuso vha ya ngei Mukumbani Musanda ha Thovhele Vho Kennedy Tshivhase, u ya u luvha.



Vho Meyara, Thovhele Vho Tshivhase, mahosi na makhantseḽara vho mbo ḓi ṱuwa vhoṱhe ngei muvhunduni wa Vhutshavhelo muḓini wa mufumakadzi Vho Ṋemavhola vha muholefhali, u vha fhulufhedzisa u fhaṱela nnḓu.





Mahosi vho mbo ḓi dzudzanya uri ngauri muḓi uyo u tsini na damu nahone kule na kiḽiniki, ndi khwine nnḓu i tshi fhaṱiwa muvhunduni wa Vonḓo ḽa Thavha hune vha vha tsini na kiliniki.








Vha tshi ṱalutshedza, Cllr Rambuḓa vho ri: “Ro ḓa fhano muḓini sa Masipala wa Thulamela ri na Vho Tshipikara ro rangiwa phanḓa nga Mukhantseḽara washu na miraḓo ya komiti ya executive na Vho Acting Chief Whip na vhaofisiri vhashu. A si u thoma ṋamusi ri tshi khou ḓa, ro thoma ra rumela vhaofisiri vhashu vha ḓa vha tshimbila na Mukhantseḽara na komiti ya wadi yavho vha tshi khou sedzulusa hafha kha heyinoni wadi, vha swika hune vha ṱangana na muḓi hoyu une ṋamusi ra vha khawo.



Vho Meyara vho ri: “Vho ḓi u ṋanguludza kha minzhi ngauri iṱali vhushai ho ya nga u sielisana. Vha tshi swika hafha vho wana uri ndi zwone huna nnḓu kheyi. Heyi nnḓu vho ḓi i fhata vha tshi edza nḓivho yavho na masheleni ane vha vha nao. Fhedzi a yo ngo tou dzudzanyea ro sedza uri huna muholefhali. Ha ḓo dovha ha vha na vhaṅwe, ndi vhanzhi vhathu vho no dzula hafha, Ndi nga si tou vha vhala fhedzi ndi vhanzi. Ndi zwone zwo itisaho uri riṋe ri ḓe ri vhone uri hoyu ane ra khou tou mupfela tshoṱhe a vhe na vhudzulo vhune na wheelchair yawe a tshi bva nḓuni a ḓo tou itelwa zwavhuḓi uri a kone bva zwavhuḓi. Vha sedza hafho huna zwiṱepisi ha dovha havha na madindi nga ngomu lune zwi vha zwi songo tou dzulisa zwone.



Vha tshi isa phanḓa Vho Meyara vho ri: “Zwino riṋe mushumo washu sa masipala a ri fhaṱi dzinnḓu. Ri tou thusedzana na muvhuso wa vunḓu. Musi ro avhela dzinnḓu ha vha huna vhaṅwe vho salelaho, riṋe sa masipala ri kona uri zwezwi ri tshi khou tshimbila kha wadi ra kona u topola vhane kudzulele kwavho a ku ngo tou vha kwavhuḓi, ra ita uri ri imeime ri kone u vha fhaṱela. Zwino na hafha ri khou ri ḓo vha fhaṱela nnḓu i no fana na dzedzi dzo no khou fhaṱiwa ano maḓuvha nga muvhuso wa vunḓu. Ri tshi khou ri hezwi ndi zwone zwo itisaho uri ri kone u ḓiwana ri hafha na Vho Thovhele Tshivhase na mahosi ashu.



Vho Meyara vho ri: “Vha ḓo zwi humbula zwa uri ri ḓi tshimbila vho ro fara. Sa zwe nda zwi sumbedzisa uri a hu ngo tou vha fhethu ha vhuḓi hu dzula vhathu vhanzhivhazhi. Ri ḓi vha vho na zwiṱuku zwa mugayo. A ri khou tou amba uri hoyu mugayo vha ḓo uḽa u swikela lini. Zwezwo zwiṱuku vha tshi khou ḓila, hu ḓo vha muṅwe ane a thusedza vho”. 



Vha tshi bva ha Vho Ṋemavhola, Vho Meyara vho ya muṱanganoni wo farelwaho Tshikoloni tsha Phuraimari ya Murangoni wo dzhenelwaho nga makhantseḽara, mahosi na vhaimeleli vha mihasho ya muvhuso hu tshi katelwa mutakalo, vhulimi na zwa muno, wa u amba nga ha nzudzanyo dza tshivhidzo.



Vha tshi ṋetshedza muvhigo wa poḽotiki, mukhatseḽara wa wadi 31, Cllr Ndavheleseni Mmbi vho ri: “Heyi wadi yoṱhe ina mivhundu ya 13. Huna zwinzhi zwe zwa itiwa nga masipala washu. Huna zwinzhi zwine zwa kha ḓi bvela phanḓa. Ha vha na zwiṅwe zwine masipala a u athu u zwi swikelela. Ndi ḓo thoma nga muḓagasi wa Gondeni na ha Mabilu we wa vha u sa athu u fungiwa tsha kalekale, fhedzi ha zwino wo fungiwa. Huna muḓagasi wa fhaḽa Phiphiḓi Muhuma seli ha boroho ya Mutshunduḓi hune hu wela kha wadi 31, ri tshi khou amba ṋamusi ho funga. Huna na huṅwe hune a hu athu u fungiwa fhedzi hu khou dzheniswa dzisoḽa. Ho no dzheniswa dzisoḽa Murangoni, Mukumbani na fhano Maranzhe.”



Kha zwa dzinnḓu, Cllr Mmbi vho ri: “Ri khou livhuwa tshumelo yo no bva ha masipala Thulamela. Dzinndu dzo ḓa. A si mivhundu yoṱhe i re na dzinnḓu, hafha hu si na dzinnḓu zwi amba zwi ḓo itiwa zwifhingani zwi ḓaho. Ri na dzinnḓu kha muvhundu wa Mukumbani dzine dza swika 20, ha Raḓali ndi 15, Tshivhungululu ndi 5, Lunungwi ndi 20, Vonḓo ndi 8, Vonḓo ḽa Thavha ndi 17, Murangoni ndi 8. Zwi amba uri nnḓu dzothe dzo ṱangana ndi 87.”

link: THULAMELA VHO RWELA ṰARI FULO ḼA ARRIVE ALIVE
text:
Masipala wa Thulamela wo rwela ṱari Fulo ḽa U Sikwa ni khou Tshila (Arrive Alive Campaign) ngei Mvuḓi Park kha bada ya R524 nga Ḽavhuraru, 04 Nyendavhusiku 2024.



Ho ranga phanḓa Meyara Cllr Vho Athongozwiḓivha Sarah Rambuḓa, fulo heḽi ḽa u khwinifhadza u tevhedzwa ha milayo ya badani ḽo vha ḽo dzhenelwa nga makhantseḽara, mapholisa a vhuendi a 42 na vha vhaimeleli vha South African National Taxi Council (Santaco).





Mushumo wo thoma nga u farwa ha muṱangano wa u ṱalutshedza vhoramafhungo nzudzanyo dzo itwaho ṋaṅwaha dza u fhelisa vhutshinyi ya badani sa ezwi hu tshi khou dzhenwa kha zwi zwifhinga zwa dziholodei dza Minidzhere na Ṅwaha Muswa.








Vha tshi ṱalutshedza, Vho Meyara vhori: “Ndi khou livhuwa tshikhala hetshi tsha u amba na vheiwe ndo imela tshitshavha tsha Thulamela. Ro kuvhangana hafha a rwela ṱari fulo ḽa 2024 Arrive Alive Campaign nga tshifhinga tshine ri khou pembelela miṅwaha ya 30 ya dimokirasi.



“Tshiṅwe tsha zwithu zwine zwa vhanga dzikhombo dza badani ndi u wanala ha zwipuka zwi sa khou ṱhogomeliwaho zwine zwo tea u valelwa madangani azwo vhusiku. Ri khou dzulela u vhona maitele haya a zwifuwo zwine zwi khou vhanga dzikhombo dzibadani ngauri vhaṋe vhazwo a vha khou zwi thogomela. Ri khou humbela vhathu vhoṱhe vha re na zwifuwo uri vha zwi ṱhogomele zwi sa dzhene dzibadani dzashu.”



Tshipikwa tsha fulo ḽa Arrive Alive ndi u ita uri hu vhe na u tevhedziwa ha milayo ya u ditsireledza badani u itela  u fhungudza nomboro ya khombo dza badani na tsireledzo ya vhaenda nga ṋayo.





U bva nga dzi 04 Nyendavhusiku 2024, Thulamela ndi fhethu hune a hu nga kondelelwi vhutshinyi badabi nahone muthu ane a ḓo fariwa a tshi kha luvhulo lwo kalulaho kana a tshi khou pfuka miṅwe milayo ya badani u ḓo livhana na ndaṱiso yo teaho.








Milaedza ya fulo ḽa 2024 ndi i tevhelaho:                                                                                                                                                                 – Vha ite uri goloi yavho yo tea u dzhena badani nahone i kha tshiimo tsha vhuḓi                                                                                          – Vha songo reila vho nwa halwa kana vho shumisa zwidzidzivhadzi                                                                                                             – Vha tevhedze tswayo dza u fhungudza luvhilo nahone vha reile vho sedza nyimele                                                                                    – Vha reile vha tshi awela u itela uri vha sa nete                                                                                                                                                           – Vha tea u ambara bannda ḽa tsireledzo tshifhinga tshoṱhe nahone vha ite uri na vhaṋameli vhavho vha amabare na vhone                                      – Vha ṱhogomele vhaṅwe vhashumisi vha bada sa vhareili vha dzibaisigira na vhaenda nga ṋayo

link: IMBIZO YA THULAMELA YO FARELWA MALAVUWE
text:
Vhadzulapo vha Malavuwe fhasi ha Masipala wa Thulamela, Ward 39, vho dzhenela Imbizo ya Meyara Cllr Vho Athongozwiḓivha Sarah Rambuḓa ngei luvhanḓeni lwa Matsika Shooting Stars nga Ḽavhuṱanu, 06 Nyendavhusiku 2024, he vha humbela nḓisedzo ya tshumelo dzo fhambananaho sa maḓi, dzibada, tsireledzo na mishumo.



Nga matsheloni musi tshivhidzo tshi sa athu thoma, makhatseḽara vha Thulamela vho thoma nga u ya musanda ngei Mbilwi u luvha kha Thovhele Gole Mphaphuli.





U bva afho goloi dza mahosi na makhantseḽara dza dubekana dzo livha ngei Malamangwa muṱani wa ha Mareḓa une wo topoliwa sa wa vhashai vhane vha tea fhatelwa nnḓu nga masipala. Vha tshi bva mulomo, Vho Phineas Mareḓa (84) vho livhuwa masipala u vha thusa nga nnḓu ngauri ndi kale vha tshi khou shaya vhudzulo.








Muduba wo mbo takutshedza wa livha Tshikoloni tsha Phuraimari ya Matsika ha farwa muṱangano vhukati ha makhantselara, vhaofisiri vha muvhuso na mahosi nga ha nḓisedzo ya tshumelo kha ḽa Malavuwe.



Khosi Vho Mafenya Mphaphuli vho sumbedzisa uri hu khou ṱahela zwithu zwo vhalaho hu tshi katelwa maḓi, dziburoho na dzibada



Ngei tshivhidzoni kha wadi iyi ya Cllr Avhapfani Khangale, vharangaphanḓa vha zwiimiswa zwa vhadzulapo vho ṋetshedzwa tshikhala tsha u amba zwililo zwavho, vha vhudziwa uri vha tou ṅwala uri zwi kone u ya u sedzuluswa na u dzudzanyiwa kha dziofisi dzo teaho.





Vha tshi fhindula kha zwo ambiwa, Vho Meyara vhori: “Ho ḓa ha ima vhafunzi hafha vho imela Pastors Forum. Ri zwine ra vha zwone nga Pastors Forum ngauri ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe vha dzula vha tshi khou ri rabelela vha tshi khou ita uri hune ra vha hone hu vhe na mulalo. Vha khou thusa nga maanḓa kha lushaka. U dovhe u sumbedzise kha vha vhafunzi vhashu na vhaṅwe vha lushaka, vho amba hafha uri badzhete dzi songo tshifitiwa. Arali ro badzheta uri ri khou ḓisa mini fhano hune ra vha hone, kha zwi ḓe hanefha.”








Vha tshi isa phanḓa vhori: “U nga vha sumbedzisa hafha uri sa Thulamela, riṋe musi ri tshi puḽana, vha tshi pfa hu tshi pfi ri khou ita road gravelling ri ita uri ri katale. Arali ri khou ḓisa khiḽomitha mbili kha dziwadi, mukhantseḽara muṅwe na muṅwe u bva kha wadi ya u thoma u swika kha wadi 41, hedzo khiḽomitha mbili u fanela u dzi wana.



“A ri iti zwa uri ri tou nanguludza ngauri vhupo hoṱhe vhu wela Thulamela. Ndi zwa vhukuma vha khou amba zwone, riṋe a ri tou funa uri ri tea vha ṋea tshumelo. Ri tou tea u vha ṋea tshumelo kana i khou tou na na tshifhango. Vho ri vhetshela zwone hafhaḽa ngauri vho tou ri khetha.”

link: MUKEGULU VHA ḒO FHAṰELWA NNḒU SA TSHUMELO YO ḒISWAHO NGA THULAMELA IMBIZO
text:
Mukegulu wa mushai Vho Elizabeth Maphaha (89) vho takala na zwikunwane musi Meyara wa Masipala wa Thulamela, Cllr Athongozwoḓivha Sarah Rambuḓa vha tshi vha dalela ngei muḓini wavho ngei Ṱhohoyanḓou Block G Ext.    



Sa tshipida tsha Imbizo yo farwaho ngei Lufule 2, kha wadi 17, nga Ḽavhuṋa, 05 Fulwi 2025,  Vho Meyara na vhurumelwa vho thoma nga u luvha kha Thovhele Vho Gole Mphaphuli ngei musanda Mbilwi, u bva afho vha kona u livha muḓini wa mukegulu Vho Maphaha u vha ḓzivhadza uri Masipala wa Thulamela u do vha fhaṱela nnḓu na u vha sia na zwifhiwa zwa zwiḽiwa na zwifuko. 





Madalo aya o dzhenelwa nga Vhamusanda Vho Mphephu Mphaphuli na makhantseḽara hu tshi katelwa Cllr Patrick Mathidi vha wadi 17 na Cllr Shonisani Cecilia Kwinḓa. Muraḓo wa wadi komiti, Vho Constance Tsaṅwani, vho ṱanganedza vhathu ngei muḓini wa mukegulu Vho Maphaha,








Vha tshi bva mulomo, Vho Meyara vho ṱalutshedza uri: “Ro takuwa u bva hangei ha masipala muhumbulo muhulwane u wa uri ri a laedziwa nga maṅwalo a milayo ya masipala uri tshifhinga tshoṱhe ri tea uya vhathuni. Ri vha ri tshi khou isa dziripoto na u pfa uri kushumele kwashu ku khou vha fara hani. Huna hune vhone vha tea uri ri eletshedza uri ndi hufhio hune a ri khou kandisa zwone, nga u tou ralo. Musi ri tshi khou ita tshivhidzo, vhaofisiri vhashu vha ya vha vho ḓa hafha kha wadi, vha tshimbila u swika na musanda.



“Mukhantseḽara wa wadi na komiti ya wadi vho ranga phanḓa vhaofisiri vha masipala vha tandula hoṱhe, Musi zwo ralo Vho Meyara vho sedza uri ndi nga ngafhi hune a vha na vhudzulo kana vhudzulo vhu hone vhu sa tou sedzea. Sa fhano hune nnḓu ya hone ri khou i sedza nga nnḓa ina mitwe. Ndi ngazwo ro dzhia tsheo heyi ya uri nnḓu ri i sie na Vho Elisa Maphaha vhane vha dzula na muḓuhulu wavho.



Vha tshi isa phanḓa, Vho Meyara vho ri: “Nṋe ndi khou vhona ho nangiwa fhethu ha vhuḓi ngauri mukegulu vha tshila nga mundende lune vha nga si tsha kona uri nnḓu heyi vha i vusuludze zwa vhuḓi. Zwine zwa amba uri musi riṋe ri tshi khou ḓa uri ri vha thuse, ri vha ri thi khou thusa muthu eneene o teaho. Riṋe zwi a mba uri ri ḓo tou fhaṱa iṅwe nnḓu ine Vho Elisa vha ḓo kona u dzula khayo na muḓuhulu wavho.”





Vha tshi fhedza u onesa kha mukegulu, Vho Meyara vho livha tshivhidzoni ngei Lufule 2, he ha thomiwa nga u farwa mutangano na zwiimiswa zwa tshitshavha.








Vha tshi ṋetshedza muvhigo wa politiki, mukhantseḽara wa wadi 17 Vho Patrick Mathidi vho ri: “Heyi wadi ina mivhundu ya malo hu tshi katelwa dzilokhishi ṱhanu na vhupo ha mahayani huraru. Kha miṅwaha miṋa yo fhelaho muvhuso wo kona u ḓisa thandela dzo fhambananaho. Kha dzibada ho itiwa dzikhiḽomitha mbili ngei Lufule 2 na dziṅwe mbili ngei ha Mabunda.



“Kha maḓi ho dzheniswa dzibommbi ngei murahu ha Mbaleni. Zwi tshi kwama vhudzulo ho fhaṱiwa dzinnḓu dza 13. Ho lugiswa na midavhi ya mitambo ngei Ṱhohoyandou G Ext. na Lufule 3. Ho dzheniswa mavhone a zwitaraṱani ngei Makwarela. Ho fhaṱwa dzibiridzhi ngei ha Mavhunda na ha Magidi”.







Nṱha u bva kha monde: Mukhantseḽara wa Wadi 17 Vho Patrick Mathidi, Meyara Cllr Sarah Rambuḓa, Thovhele Gole Mphaphuli, Cllr Shonisani Cecilia Kwinḓa na Cllr Mutshutshudzi Mphaphuli ngei musanda Mbilwi 




Nṱha u bva kha monde: Vho Constance Tsaṅwani vha Wadi Komiti, Mukhantseḽara wa Wadi 17 Vho Patrick Mathidi, Vhamusanda Vho Mphephu Mphaphuli, Meyara Cllr Sarah Rambuḓa, Mukegulu Vho Elizabeth Maphaha na Cllr Shonisani Cecilia Kwinḓa

link: Limpopo urges road users to exercise caution following flooding in Mopani and Vhembe
text:
The Limpopo Department of Transport and Community Safety has urged motorists, pedestrians and all road users to exercise extreme caution when travelling, particularly near low-lying bridges and flooded roads, following flooding incidents reported in parts of the Mopani and Vhembe Districts. 



In a statement on Sunday, the department said persistent heavy rainfall in the affected areas has resulted in dangerous road conditions, with reports of flooding-related incidents and loss of lives. 





According to the department, distressing reports have been received of people losing their lives after attempting to cross flooded streams, rivers and bridges. The adverse weather conditions have rendered certain roads unsafe and significantly increased the risk of fatal accidents. 








MEC for Transport and Community Safety, Violet Mathye, expressed concern over the situation and appealed to road users to avoid taking unnecessary risks. 



“We are deeply concerned about the loss of lives reported in Mopani and Vhembe. We urge motorists and pedestrians to refrain from crossing flooded roads and low-lying bridges. No destination is worth a human life. Floodwaters are unpredictable and can easily sweep away both people and vehicles,” Mathye said.



The MEC also called on communities to cooperate with traffic officers, law enforcement agencies and disaster management teams that have been deployed across the province to monitor the situation and assist where necessary. 





The department advised road users to avoid crossing flooded roads and low-lying bridges, even when water appears shallow, and to obey road closure signs as well as instructions from traffic officials.








Motorists are further encouraged to use alternative routes where available, reduce speed and maintain safe following distances during wet and rainy conditions. Special caution has been urged to ensure the safety of pedestrians and learners, particularly in flood-prone areas. 



Traffic officers and disaster management teams remain on high alert and continue to monitor road conditions across the affected districts. 



The department extended its sincere condolences to the families affected by the recent tragic incidents and reiterated its call for vigilance and responsible road use during adverse weather conditions. 



Road users are encouraged to stay informed through official alerts from the South African Weather Service and to report emergencies to local authorities. – SAnews
